/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/ak-msafr-qaid-hai-bimar-hai.md\")
before = p.read_bytes()
prefix, remainder = before.split(b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\", 1)
_, body = remainder.split(b\"\\n---\\n\", 1)
roman = \"\"\"  Ik musafir qaid hai bimaar hai

  1
  Karwaan-e-sabr ka salaar hai

  2
  Dard sar pe paaoṅ mein haiṅ beriyaaṅ
  Aur gale mein tauq ka ik haar hai

  3
  Khun aaṅkhoṅ se rawaaṅ phir ho gaya
  Saamne jo Shaam ka bazaar hai

  4
  Haaye qismat wa gharibi ya Husain
  Karbala mein lut gaya ghar baar hai

  5
  Ghash pe ghash Maula ko khaime mein pare
  Har qadam chalne se woh laachaar hai

  6
  Is se ziyaada aur kya ho ga sitam
  Maaṅ behen sab beridaa darbaar hai

  7
  Haaye aayateṅ Quraani beridaa
  Rehm malik majma-e-aghyaar hai

  8
  Khun aaṅkhoṅ se rawaaṅ phir ho gaya
  Saamne jo Shaam ka bazaar hai

  9
  De do chaadar har qadam kehta raha
  Sayyed-e-Sajjaad jo salaar hai

  10
  Karwaane sabr ka salaar hai\"\"\"
after = prefix + b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\" + roman.encode() + b\"\\n---\\n\" + body
roman_blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in roman.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")]
source_blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in body.decode().strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")]
assert list(map(len, roman_blocks)) == list(map(len, source_blocks))
for n, (r, s) in enumerate(zip(roman_blocks[1:], source_blocks[1:]), 1):
    assert r[0].strip() == s[0].translate(str.maketrans(\"۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹\", \"0123456789\")) == str(n)
assert sum(map(len, roman_blocks)) - 10 == 19
p.write_bytes(after)
assert p.read_bytes() == after
print(\"Verified 19 aligned verses, opening and 10 numbered stanzas, with unchanged Urdu body and other metadata.\")
PY"

item.text:
Audited all 19 verses and aligned the Roman transliteration with the Urdu opening and 10 stanzas. Removed Roman-only recording labels and extra refrain repeats, corrected spellings and nasal endings against the Urdu, and preserved the repeated stanza present in the source. The Urdu body and other metadata are unchanged.

Retained the existing reading `Rehm malik` in stanza 7 because the unvowelled Urdu leaves its pronunciation open.
